info.description:
A Power Platform custom connector for location-based hazard detection, designed for Field Service dispatch scenarios.
The core problem: before sending a field engineer to a location, you want to know if anything dangerous has happened nearby recently, natural disasters, conflict events, infrastructure failures. This connector brings that data into Power Platform so it can be used inside flows, model-driven apps, and work order routing logic.

get.description: Returns earthquake events within a radius of a coordinate

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the center point (e.g. 30.0 for Cairo)

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the center point (e.g. 31.2 for Cairo)

parameters.name: maxradiuskm
parameters.description: Search radius in kilometers around the center point

parameters.name: starttime
parameters.description: Start of the date window — format YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: endtime
parameters.description: End of the date window — format YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: minmagnitude
parameters.description: Minimum earthquake magnitude to include (0–10 scale). Default 4.0 filters minor tremors

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: LimitMaximum number of events to return. Default 20, max 20000.
